newsitem.title: USA: Reading & Bates says rig utilization up in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Reading & Bates says rig utilization up in Q2.

text.p: Reading & Bates Corp said on Tuesday that average rig utilization in the second quarter improved to 98 percent from 89 percent a year ago.

It reported a $36.7 million improvement in revenue in the second quarter of 1997 to $98.4 million from a year ago, due to improved rig utilization and dayrates and the addition of two vessels to its fleet.
Net income for the second quarter was $20.2 million, or $0.28 per share, compared with analysts' expectations of $0.23 per share.
